parole.significato: hongweibing, red guard (member of any of several organizations known as Red Guards or Red Guard)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian хунвейби́н (xunvejbín), from Mandarin 紅衛兵／红卫兵 (hóngwèibīng).

parole.significato: ginseng (any plant of the genus Panax)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian женьше́нь (ženʹšénʹ), from Mandarin 人參／人参 (rénshēn).
